items.name: Merger Agreement with American Ocean Minerals Corporation (AOM)
items.claim: On April 8, 2026, Odyssey entered into an Agreement and Plan of Merger with its wholly owned subsidiary Oceanus Merger Sub, Inc. and American Ocean Minerals Corporation (AOM); under the agreement Merger Sub will merge with and into AOM, with AOM surviving as a direct, wholly owned subsidiary of Odyssey, and each outstanding share of AOM common stock will convert into Odyssey common stock at a fixed exchange ratio of 4.5017 shares (proportionately adjusted to 0.1801 to give effect to Odyssey's planned 1-for-25 reverse stock split); following completion Odyssey is expected to be renamed American Ocean Minerals Corporation and trade on Nasdaq under the symbol AOMC.
items.source_excerpt: As previously disclosed, on April 8, 2026, Odyssey entered into an Agreement and Plan of Merger with its wholly owned subsidiary, Oceanus Merger Sub, Inc. (“Merger Sub”), and AOM (the “Merger Agreement”). Under the Merger Agreement, Merger Sub will merge with and into AOM, with AOM surviving as a direct, wholly owned subsidiary of Odyssey. At the effective time of the merger, each outstanding share of AOM common stock will be converted into shares of Odyssey common stock at a fixed exchange ratio of 4.5017 shares of Odyssey common stock for each share of AOM common stock, which exchange ratio will be proportionately adjusted to 0.1801 to give effect to the 1-for-25 reverse stock split that Odyssey intends to effect after the effectiveness of the registration statement of which this proxy statement/prospectus forms a part but before completion of the merger.
